en.title: Number of Key Changes Ignoring Case
en.description:
Ignoring case, count how many times the letter changes between adjacent typed characters.

This site's standard input/output is stated explicitly; ranges not given by the source problem are marked as this site's conventions.
en.input: One line containing a string of English letters, of length 1..1000 (this site inputs the character sequence as a contiguous string of ASCII English letters).
en.explanation: Example 1: w changes to a, and a changes to b, 2 times in total. Example 2: among w, w, a, w, a there are 3 changes. Example 3: every letter is a, so there are 0 changes.
hints: Scan the lowercase forms of adjacent characters and add 1 whenever they differ.
